narratives.title: Sanctuary returns Ponder for a second cast
narratives.result: Three other Islands let Sanctuary enter untapped. Its triggered ability targeted the previously cast Ponder in the graveyard and put it on top. The diagnostic draw and a second source-paid cast produced another Pyromancer Elemental: two in total.

narratives.title: Sanctuary target leaving the graveyard causes the trigger to fail
narratives.result: The trigger chose Ponder when placed on the stack. A declared synthetic response moved that exact graveyard object to exile; on resolution the trigger had no legal target and did not return it. No printed graveyard-exile card was added by this scenario.

narratives.title: Fiery Islet pays life for mana, then later sacrifices to draw
narratives.result: An actual Fiery Islet mana activation produced U and paid one life without damage. After a declared next-turn untap, a different land paid the one-mana draw-ability cost; Islet was tapped and sacrificed before the card was drawn.

narratives.title: A spell resolves before the waiting Islet draw
narratives.result: The Islet draw ability paid its source and mana costs. Brainstorm was cast in response, completing its draw and put-back choices before the Islet ability resolved and drew its card.

narratives.title: Riptide, Adaptation, Harmonic and a response
narratives.result: Adaptation made Iconoclast a Wizard, enabling Riptide. In response, Capsize bounced that same creature; the Riptide ability then failed its target check. Capsize had already triggered the adapted Iconoclast twice through Harmonic, creating two Soldiers.

narratives.title: Removing Adaptation makes the Riptide target illegal
narratives.result: Capsize returned Adaptation while the Riptide ability waited. Iconoclast remained on the battlefield but lost the Wizard subtype; Riptide rechecked its target and failed without returning it.
